    14  
    15  This file sets up the basic theory of fixed points of a monotone function in a complete lattice.
    16  
    17  ## Main definitions
    18  
    19  * `OrderHom.lfp`: The least fixed point of a bundled monotone function.
    20  * `OrderHom.gfp`: The greatest fixed point of a bundled monotone function.
    21  * `OrderHom.prevFixed`: The greatest fixed point of a bundled monotone function smaller than or
    22    equal to a given element.
    23  * `OrderHom.nextFixed`: The least fixed point of a bundled monotone function greater than or
    24    equal to a given element.
    25  * `fixedPoints.completeLattice`: The Knaster-Tarski theorem: fixed points of a monotone
    26    self-map of a complete lattice form themselves a complete lattice.
    27  
    28  ## Tags
    29  
    30  fixed point, complete lattice, monotone function

    48  /-- Least fixed point of a monotone function -/
    49  def lfp : (α →o α) →o α where
    50    toFun f := sInf { a | f a ≤ a }
    51    monotone' _ _ hle := sInf_le_sInf fun a ha => (hle a).trans ha
    52  
    53  /-- Greatest fixed point of a monotone function -/
    54  def gfp : (α →o α) →o α where
    55    toFun f := sSup { a | a ≤ f a }
    56    monotone' _ _ hle := sSup_le_sSup fun a ha => le_trans ha (hle a)
    57  
    58  theorem lfp_le {a : α} (h : f a ≤ a) : f.lfp ≤ a :=
    59    sInf_le h
    60  
    61  theorem lfp_le_fixed {a : α} (h : f a = a) : f.lfp ≤ a :=
    62    f.lfp_le h.le

    15  # Intermediate Value Theorem
    16  
    17  In this file we prove the Intermediate Value Theorem: if `f : α → β` is a function defined on a
    18  connected set `s` that takes both values `≤ a` and values `≥ a` on `s`, then it is equal to `a` at
    19  some point of `s`. We also prove that intervals in a dense conditionally complete order are
    20  preconnected and any preconnected set is an interval. Then we specialize IVT to functions continuous
    21  on intervals.
    22  
    23  ## Main results
    24  
    25  * `IsPreconnected_I??` : all intervals `I??` are preconnected,
    26  * `IsPreconnected.intermediate_value`, `intermediate_value_univ` : Intermediate Value Theorem for
    27    connected sets and connected spaces, respectively;
    28  * `intermediate_value_Icc`, `intermediate_value_Icc'`: Intermediate Value Theorem for functions
    29    on closed intervals.
    30  
    31  ### Miscellaneous facts
    32  
    33  * `IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_mem_nhdsWithin` : “Continuous induction” principle;
    34    if `s ∩ [a, b]` is closed, `a ∈ s`, and for each `x ∈ [a, b) ∩ s` some of its right neighborhoods
    35    is included in `s`, then `[a, b] ⊆ s`.
    36  * `IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_exists_gt`, `IsClosed.mem_of_ge_of_forall_exists_gt` : two
    37    other versions of the “continuous induction” principle.
    38  * `ContinuousOn.StrictMonoOn_of_InjOn_Ioo` :

    40    or antitone (increasing or decreasing).

    55  /-!
    56  ### Intermediate value theorem on a (pre)connected space
    57  
    58  In this section we prove the following theorem (see `IsPreconnected.intermediate_value₂`): if `f`
    59  and `g` are two functions continuous on a preconnected set `s`, `f a ≤ g a` at some `a ∈ s` and
    60  `g b ≤ f b` at some `b ∈ s`, then `f c = g c` at some `c ∈ s`. We prove several versions of this
    61  statement, including the classical IVT that corresponds to a constant function `g`.
    62  -/
    63  
    64  section
    65  
    66  variable {X : Type u} {α : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [LinearOrder α] [TopologicalSpace α]
    67    [OrderClosedTopology α]
    68  
    69  /-- Intermediate value theorem for two functions: if `f` and `g` are two continuous functions
    70  on a preconnected space and `f a ≤ g a` and `g b ≤ f b`, then for some `x` we have `f x = g x`. -/
    71  theorem intermediate_value_univ₂ [PreconnectedSpace X] {a b : X} {f g : X → α} (hf : Continuous f)
    72      (hg : Continuous g) (ha : f a ≤ g a) (hb : g b ≤ f b) : ∃ x, f x = g x := by
    73    obtain ⟨x, _, hfg, hgf⟩ : (univ ∩ { x | f x ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ f x }).Nonempty :=
    74      isPreconnected_closed_iff.1 PreconnectedSpace.isPreconnected_univ _ _ (isClosed_le hf hg)
    75        (isClosed_le hg hf) (fun _ _ => le_total _ _) ⟨a, trivial, ha⟩ ⟨b, trivial, hb⟩
    76    exact ⟨x, le_antisymm hfg hgf⟩
    77  
    78  theorem intermediate_value_univ₂_eventually₁ [PreconnectedSpace X] {a : X} {l : Filter X} [NeBot l]
    79      {f g : X → α} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (ha : f a ≤ g a) (he : g ≤ᶠ[l] f) :
    80      ∃ x, f x = g x :=
